notes: Self-declared 3D tower-defense MVP, so Strategy leads; the player walking the map with a basic attack and the barracks swordsmen are units inside the tower-defense loop, not a second genre. Shape is lane-actor-track because the prompt specifies one winding but readable route from a single spawn area to the castle at its end and says enemies stay on it unless briefly engaging soldiers — the lane's continuity is the game, so its P6 stands. This is one compact map with no lobby and no second scene, so nothing earns P4 and the route stays entirely on the proven pipeline. Decided without a user: buildzone-grid expresses the two predefined construction locations and their paired build/upgrade interaction tiles from the answer rather than a full flanking grid, the player does walk the map so no SET applies, and the ~20-second goblin walk sets the compact scale.
